title: Mavlink_Vision positioning output
current_gap: The vision positioning message, its frame/covariance/sample-time semantics and the estimator integration contract are missing; the #30 real-camera image path is not evidence for this mode.

atoms.name: vision_message_set
atoms.required: Pinned vision positioning message(s) with field map from a fixed dialect source

atoms.name: coordinate_covariance
atoms.required: Frame, units and covariance semantics pinned and validated

atoms.name: sampling_time
atoms.required: Sample time versus authoritative sim time semantics; capture time is not estimate time

atoms.name: estimator_integration
atoms.required: Estimator input contract per supported stack with acceptance/rejection evidence

atoms.name: capture_path_distinction
atoms.required: The #30 RGB capture path stays image evidence; it never substitutes for a vision-position message

scope_rule: a camera image with pose metadata is not a vision-position estimate; estimator acceptance is proven per stack, not assumed

followups.blocked_by: Fixed dialect source and message choice

preserved.issue_30: closed RGB capture slice; image evidence only
